title: Collapse the fine-grained git-plumbing codes to one message-carrying error

outcomes.statement: The residual git operations raise a single WR_GIT_ERROR carrying the underlying message, instead of twelve variants distinguishing shades of the same failure.
outcomes.demo: Every WR_GIT_* variant except WR_GIT_ERROR is absent from enforcement, and the git-failure tests assert the carried message rather than a code taxonomy.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the clock removal made most git-plumbing failure modes go away, as the parent design §4 states.
uncertainties.resolution: It did not. Measured after CHG-037: 13 git invocations across 8 subcommands remain (show x4, rev-list x3, ls-tree x3, merge-base x2, ls-files, rev-parse x2, write-tree, commit-tree). The collapse stands on §4's other ground — these codes have no distinct remedy — and covers 10 of the 15 WR_GIT_* codes, not 12+ of them.
